name: Linear stage / a decision with evidence
description: Inspect a grouped assembly, retain a failed nominal clearance check, follow the revision, and replay a prescribed travel fixture.

stages.title: What stops the carriage?
stages.description: A guide and sliding carriage need nominal clearance. The original slot is narrower than the guide. Inspect the drive and hardware groups.

stages.title: Keep the failed fit.
stages.description: An 18 mm slot around a 20 mm guide gives −2 mm total clearance. The nominal fit fails. Open Project record for the original result and revision decision.

stages.title: Change one dimension.
stages.description: The revised slot is 24 mm wide, giving 4 mm total nominal clearance. This observed dimension check does not establish tolerance, load or physical acceptance.

stages.title: Inspect the recorded travel.
stages.description: Three named bodies retain their recorded poses. The carriage travels 180 mm in a prescribed adapter fixture; a dynamics engine has not solved this motion.

revisions.decision: Initial grouped assembly. The 18 mm slot interferes with the 20 mm guide by 2 mm in total.
Increase only the slot width to 24 mm. Retain the earlier failure and check nominal clearance again.

evidence.scope: One dimensional nominal clearance only. Tolerances, loads, friction and physical fit are unverified.
One dimensional nominal clearance only. Tolerances, loads, friction and physical fit are unverified.
Recorded prescribed travel for adapter inspection; no dynamics solution or physical test.
